quotes.text: `graph.knownHashes` is a loaded/display cache, not repository membership. `commands/graph/commit-access.mjs:ensureGraphCommit()` accepts hexadecimal commit IDs and probes `git cat-file -e <hash>^{commit}`; use it for actions on commits that may lie outside the current page while preserving invalid-ID, missing-object, unknown-checkout, and token errors.
